claims.claim_text: The section describes processes used to identify, assess, prioritise and monitor climate-related risks, including key inputs, scenario analysis links in the risk register, a defined risk rating methodology, monitoring at different frequencies, and integration into overall ERM.
claims.support_notes: High-level narrative in draft_markdown aligns to IFRS S1/S2 risk management disclosure objectives; specific sub-claims below provide evidence detail.

claims.claim_text: The entity identifies climate-related risks across its operations and financing activities, including exposures arising through lending and counterparties.
claims.support_notes: Stated explicitly in section 1; no structured evidence item provided beyond narrative.

claims.claim_text: Value-chain climate risk considerations include operations and travel generating Scope 1–2 emissions and facing physical disruption.
claims.support_notes: Narrative statement; no underlying emissions dataset evidenced in provided evidence_items.

claims.claim_text: Lending to the sector "Other mining and quarrying" is associated with elevated transition risk arising from carbon pricing and demand shifts.
claims.support_notes: Narrative framing of where risks arise; no portfolio metrics evidenced in evidence_items.

claims.claim_text: Physical risk exposure assessment uses external climate indicator inputs, including ECB climate indicators, referenced consistently across physical risk exposure records.
claims.support_notes: Draft states ECB indicators used; no evidence_item explicitly showing ECB indicator field/path in the truncated evidence list.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related scenario analysis is referenced in the climate risk register through explicit links to scenario analysis identifiers, including SCN0009, SCN0007, SCN0011 and SCN0005.
claims.support_notes: At least one scenario link (SCN0009) is evidenced in evidence_items; other IDs are asserted in narrative but not evidenced in provided items.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks are assessed using a structured scoring approach that includes likelihood scoring; likelihood scores recorded include 3, 4 and 5.
claims.support_notes: Evidence shows likelihood_score=4 for one entry; scores 3 and 5 are narrative-only in provided excerpt.

claims.claim_text: Risk ratings are derived from a 5x5 risk matrix using likelihood_score * severity_score with thresholds: low < 3, medium >= 3, high >= 8, critical >= 15 (bands also described as 1-2 low, 3-6 medium, 8-12 high, 15-25 critical).
claims.support_notes: Methodology is stated in narrative; no evidence_items provided for severity_score or computed rating logic.

claims.claim_text: Consistent with the stated methodology, the climate risk register includes risks rated "medium".

The climate risk register includes a documented physical risk description: "Chronic heat and shifting precipitation reduce yields for agricultural counterparties, weakening repayment capacity over the medium term."
claims.support_notes: Exact text is evidenced in evidence_items.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risk management is integrated into the entity’s overall ERM process for many climate-related risks, evidenced by ERM integration flag set to True for multiple entries.
claims.support_notes: At least one entry shows erm_integrated_flag=True; claim of "multiple" entries is narrative-only in provided excerpt.

claims.claim_text: ERM integration is not universal: at least one climate-related risk is recorded with ERM integration flag set to False.
claims.support_notes: Narrative asserts existence of a False flag, but no evidence_item with erm_integrated_flag=False is included in the provided excerpt.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks are monitored at different frequencies depending on the risk, including monthly, quarterly and semi-annual monitoring.
claims.support_notes: Monthly frequency is evidenced for one entry; quarterly and semi-annual are narrative-only in provided excerpt.

claims.claim_text: The climate risk register includes an indicator of whether a risk has changed since the prior reporting period, with some entries True and some False.
entities: changed since prior reporting period indicator
claims.support_notes: False is evidenced for one entry; the claim that some entries are True is not evidenced in the provided excerpt.

claims.claim_text: The section does not describe processes used to identify, assess, prioritise and monitor sustainability-related (or climate-related) opportunities.
